risks.risk: Unknown model number/variant (affects parts availability and exact comparable pricing).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model/serial rating plate (usually inside the door frame or at the back/side) showing Model No. and Serial No.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic LG DirectDrive 7kg front-load with unknown variant; worst-case parts/compatibility risk.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: pump/drain problem, noisy bearings, or motor faults.
risks.proof: Short video of a full test cycle (wash + spin) or at least: power on, start cycle, and spin reaching high RPM without error.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to work properly; worst-case treated as needs service.

risks.risk: Rust/staining at the lower front edge may indicate water ingress, corrosion, or damaged base components.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rust area plus underside/base area (if accessible) and the door seal/gasket condition.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case for corrosion-related wear (lower value due to potential future repairs).

risks.risk: Door seal/gasket and drum condition (mold, leaks, or damaged seal) not confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo of the rubber door gasket (around the full circumference) and a photo of the drum interior for stains/tears.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if seal/drum condition is unknown (worst-case: may require cleaning/repair).

risks.risk: Accessories/installation items missing (inlet hose, drain hose, manual) affecting buyer cost.
risks.proof: Photo of included hoses/accessories and what exactly comes with the machine.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the model/serial rating plate (Model No. + Serial No.).
Video of a complete wash/spin test cycle showing no error codes.
Close-up photos of the rust/staining area and the door gasket (full circumference).
Photos of included hoses/accessories (inlet hose, drain hose, power cable condition).
response.reason: The photos confirm it is an LG DirectDrive 7kg front-load washer, but there’s no proof of working condition or the exact model number; rust is visible and could affect value. Without a test cycle and model plate, pricing safely requires proof.
